yt_title: 5 document workflows AI agents run for you 📄🤖 #Shorts
yt_description:
Drowning in documents nobody has time to read? Resumes, case files, briefs, invoices and contracts, all read by hand.

Stackby AI field agents read every document you drop into a table: they identify the type, extract the key fields, write a one-line summary and set the next step, so the workflow starts on its own. Use your own AI key from Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI (ChatGPT) or Google (Gemini).

5 document workflows in the video
1. Resume screening → interview pipeline
2. Legal case intake → summaries, deadlines and priority
3. Content briefs → tasks for the team
4. Invoices & receipts → approvals and payments
5. Contracts, leases & claims → renewal and review dates

More documents agents can handle: insurance claims, KYC and IDs, purchase orders, research and reports.
